remarks:
Welcome to 475 Hickory Street, Buffalo, NY!

Discover the perfect blend of comfort, charm, and convenience in this beautifully laid-out home, ideally situated in the heart of Buffalo! Nestled in a quiet residential neighborhood just minutes from downtown, this property offers a wonderful opportunity for homeowners and investors alike.

Step inside to find a welcoming and spacious living room with direct access to the backyard, creating a seamless connection between indoor and outdoor living. The first floor also features a dedicated dining room, a functional kitchen, and a conveniently located half bathroom, offering an ideal layout for everyday living and entertaining.

Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms filled with possibilities, along with a full bathroom. The basement adds even more versatility to the home, featuring an additional full bathroom, a bonus room that can accommodate a variety of uses, and extra storage space.

Location is everything!! Enjoy the convenience of being close to downtown Buffalo, shopping, dining, entertainment, and other everyday amenities, all while enjoying the comfort of a peaceful residential setting.

Whether you're searching for a place to call home or your next investment opportunity, 475 Hickory Street is a property you won't want to miss - discover everything this home has to offer!
facts: Separate Formal Dining Room, Separate Formal Living Room, Storage
